summary.en: A ruled paper card beside the exhibit: a title with its exhibit tab, rows of label and value, a rule, the computed result struck with the highlighter.
summary.zh: 证物旁一张画格的纸卡：带证物标签的标题、名称与数值各行、一条横线、被荧光笔划出的计算结果。

fits: Computing in the open from published figures.
notFor: Tables to read (show the page); more than five rows.

intent.en: Show the arithmetic, so the result can be checked.
intent.zh: 把算式摆出来，结果可以核对。

content.en: A title (≤ 16 chars), 1–5 rows, a value and caption.
content.zh: 一个标题（≤ 7 字），1–5 行，一个数值和说明。

fits.zh: 用发布的数字当面计算。

notFor.zh: 要阅读的表格（直接展示页面）；超过五行。

en: Values derived by reading a chart are marked ~ and listed in the film's notes.
zh: 从图上读出的数值标 ~，并记在片子的说明里。
